title: Tree Reduction Game
statement: In a two-player tree game (n up to 5·10^5), the mover either shifts the root to a never-rooted child or deletes a child's subtree; whoever cannot move loses. Bob picks the start root; all winning starts are listed. The visited side collapses to one delete-only child, so each directed edge p→c is a position, losing iff deg(c) is even and no onward edge loses; rerooting DP evaluates every root.
